messages:
maria: Quick sync — AtlasHW marketplace launch is T-4 weeks. We need a lightweight but reliable partner escalation path (shared channel + war room pattern + clear handoffs). Sketch below, please flag gaps or blockers.

alex: +1. Naming convention idea: `#partner-atlashw-triage` -> `#partner-atlashw-warroom` when escalated. Also recommend a single rotation `partner-atlashw-oncall` that pages SRE primary.

kevin: Agreed on rotation. Routing thought: partner channel = L1 (CS + partner eng). If no ack in 10m -> auto-create war room and page `partner-oncall` (SRE primary). If war room indicates infra, page `eng-infra`.

jess: CS will own first touch and the shared status doc. I'll prepare a status template: one-line impact, ETA, mitigation, next steps. We should also standardize the partner-visible incident cadence (every 15m).

aman: Security check: for private customers we need the war room bridge to be behind the customer's VPC peering or use a dedicated encrypted bridge. Also insist on KMS-backed keys for any logs shared. I'll draft the short security checklist.

maria: Here's a minimal runbook snippet I propose (for quick copy into the doc):
```
1) Post in #partner-atlashw-triage and @partner-liaison (CS)
2) Triage 0-10m: collect logs, partner contact, reproduce steps
3) If unresolved -> incident-bot create war room (#partner-atlashw-w1) and page @partner-oncall
4) War room steps: assign owner, run quick mitigations, notify customer every 15m, escalate to eng-infra or partner-eng as needed
5) Post postmortem template link and set follow-up call within 72h
```

kevin: Can we automate the 10m timer? ops-bot can spawn the war room if no reaction emoji from partner or CS within 10m. ops-bot already handles bridge creation in other channels.

alex: We should also embed a tiny troubleshooting checklist for known AtlasHW failure modes: power-cycle GPU nodes, check driver mismatch, quantization mismatch (model variant). I'll add in the runbook.

jess: Action: I'll own the status doc + initial channel message template. Maria — can you own the partner-side contact matrix (names, pager numbers, escalation hours)?

maria: Yep, I'll get partner POCs and oncall windows by EOD Friday.

aman: I'll add the KMS requirement to the runbook and a quick playbook for sensitive logs (ps: no raw customer data in public channels).

incident-bot: War room creation template ready. Use `/create-warroom partner-atlashw` to auto-build channel, set retention to 30d and attach status doc.

kevin: Test plan: schedule a simulated SEV drill with AtlasHW next Tues 09:30 PT — 30m drill. Purpose: validate channel creation, ops-bot automation, and paging handoffs.

maria: Drill sounds great. If folks agree, I'll schedule and invite partner reps + CS + SRE + eng-infra.

alex: :thumbsup: please include the runbook link in the calendar invite.

jess: I'll prepare the customer-facing template and the internal timeline checklist.

maria: Ok team — thanks. Final ask: reply with :thumbsup: if you can attend the drill Tue 09:30 PT. If not, pls share alternate. I'll publish the runbook draft to the partnership drive after this thread.

kevin: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:
